principles.statement: The AI calls burn-graph; burn-graph never calls an AI.
principles.test: No production dependency or code path launches a model or provider.

principles.statement: The CLI is the only supported writer.
principles.test: Every mutation passes schema, revision, transaction, and event gates.

principles.statement: Parallel work must still converge deterministically.
principles.test: Every activated branch settles and every cycle is bounded before End completes.

principles.statement: Humans see the same facts the AI changes.
principles.test: CLI snapshot, Mermaid projection, and Viewer derive from one runtime state.
The default server binds loopback and no telemetry or cloud API exists.
